note: Anti-IGF1R antibodies went into NSCLC on human tumour xenografts (A549) where they nearly abolished growth combined with chemotherapy or EGFR blockade; randomized add-on trials showed no benefit.
label: NSCLC (anti-IGF1R)

engagement.model: Human tumour cells and xenografts treated with h7C10 (dalotuzumab)
engagement.note: h7C10 blocked IGF-1-induced IGF-1R and IRS-1 phosphorylation in human tumour cells; no patient tumour readout yet.
engagement.quote: Analysis of the IGF-I transduction cascade demonstrated that the humanized anti-IGF-IR antibody and its murine parental form block IGF-I-induced tyrosine phosphorylation, both its beta-chain and IRS-1 tyrosine phosphorylation.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry at the first published use of a member antibody (dalotuzumab parent h7C10) in an NSCLC xenograft.

engagement.model: Human tumour cells and xenografts treated with h7C10 (dalotuzumab)
engagement.note: Paired biopsies in dalotuzumab-treated patients showed lower tumour IGF-1R and downstream signalling, the readout the model used.
engagement.quote: Decreases in tumor IGF-1R, downstream receptor signaling, and Ki67 expression were observed.
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; mixed solid tumours (phase I), not NSCLC only; engagement does not require the context's disease.
engagement.reason: Tumour IGF-1R signalling fell in patients
engagement.judgement: Paired the model paper's phosphorylation-blockade readout with patient biopsy receptor and signalling decreases; called direct because the readout is the target itself.
engagement.magnitude_basis: tumour IGF-1R and phospho-signalling, direction only

dose.model: A549 NSCLC xenografts in nude mice
dose.note: The xenograft work stated no target exposure or tolerated margin; clinical doses came from phase I PK, and cixutumumab plus erlotinib proved hard to tolerate. Track scored for cixutumumab, whose patients the quote reports; the xenografts used h7C10 (dalotuzumab), so product not in model.
dose.quote: The combinations of cixutumumab at 6 mg/kg every 7 days and 15 mg/kg every 21 days and full-dose erlotinib are not tolerable in unselected patients with NSCLC, as measured by DLT.
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of Goetsch 2005 and Weickhardt 2012; no FDA or EMA review exists for any member in NSCLC, so model_filed is unavailable.
dose.reason: No model exposure target to compare
dose.judgement: Weickhardt shows dose-limiting rash and fatigue with erlotinib, but with no model-stated tolerability margin the brief's toxicity row with no stated margin gives untested.

efficacy.model: A549 NSCLC xenografts in nude mice
efficacy.note: h7C10 with vinorelbine or anti-EGFR antibody almost abolished A549 tumour growth and prolonged survival orthotopically.
efficacy.quote: An almost complete inhibition of A549 tumor growth was observed when mice were treated with the anti-IGF-IR antibody combined with either a chemotherapeutic agent, Vinorelbine or an anti-epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) antibody, 225.
efficacy.judgement: Chose the dalotuzumab-parent A549 xenograft as the class's NSCLC model: it is a member antibody in an NSCLC xenograft and tested the same add-on combinations the trials ran.

efficacy.model: A549 NSCLC xenografts in nude mice
efficacy.note: Teprotumumab (R1507) added to erlotinib did not raise 12-week PFS (37% and 44% vs 39%) in unselected NSCLC. Combination trial (R1507 plus erlotinib against erlotinib plus placebo), scored on its primary 12-week PFS rate.
efficacy.quote: The combination of R1507 with erlotinib did not provide PFS or survival advantage over erlotinib alone in an unselected group of patients with advanced NSCLC.
efficacy.confidence_note: Full-text sections read via PMC (PMC5320944); xenograft side abstract-level.
efficacy.judgement: Paired the xenograft combination result with the first randomized NSCLC trial of a member; the trial drug (R1507) differs from the model's antibody (h7C10), so product_in_model false. Later cixutumumab trials agree and are listed as patient_trials.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: 12-week PFS rate, add-on vs control, against near-complete xenograft growth inhibition
efficacy.population: Unselected advanced NSCLC after 1-2 prior regimens

patient_trials.quote: The 12-week PFS rates were 39%, 37%, and 44%, and the median overall survival was 8.1, 8.1, and 12.1 months for the three groups, respectively, with statistically nonsignificant hazard ratios.
Efficacy was not improved in patients with nonsquamous NSCLC when cixutumumab was added to pemetrexed/cisplatin.
The addition of cixutumumab to CPB increased toxicity without improving efficacy and is not recommended for further development in non-small-cell lung cancer.

efficacy.note: Panel predicted high total tumour IGF-1R picks R1507 responders; Roche's biomarker analysis of the R1507+erlotinib trial (Habben 2011) could not be read verbatim.
efficacy.quote: In NSCLC cell lines, high levels of total IGF-1R are associated with moderate sensitivity to R1507. These results suggest a possible enrichment strategy for clinical trials with anti-IGF-1R therapy.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. Patient-side test is Habben et al., J Clin Oncol 29:15_suppl 7584 (ASCO 2011, doi:10.1200/jco.2011.29.15_suppl.7584): a search summary says IGF1R H-score subgroups showed no PFS difference, which would make this contra, but the abstract text was not retrievable (403), so no quote and the status stays untested.
efficacy.judgement: Cell lines in vitro are not an enum kind; ex_vivo used as the closest non-animal kind. Ramalingam 2011 cites this panel but does not compare it with trial biomarker data (biomarkers 'reported separately'), so it is not a stated comparison.
efficacy.population: NSCLC, total IGF-1R high vs low
efficacy.model: 22-line NSCLC cell panel treated with R1507 (total IGF-1R as response marker)

efficacy.note: In the randomized R1507+erlotinib trial (NO21160), tumour IGF-1R level defined no subgroup that benefited on the primary 12-week PFS rate, against the panel's prediction. Combination trial with erlotinib, scored on its primary endpoint within IGF1R subgroups.
efficacy.short: Tumour IGF-1R did not pick R1507 responders
efficacy.quote: No significant impact on the treatment was observed when the PFS rates of patient subgroups defined by other biomarkers, including IGF1R level, were compared within each treatment arm and between placebo and treatment arms.
efficacy.confidence_note: ASCO 2011 meeting abstract (J Clin Oncol 29:15_suppl 7584), read verbatim on ascopubs; no full paper. IGF1R measured as membrane IHC H-score, Gong used total IGF-1R in cell lines.
efficacy.reason: Total IGF-1R did not enrich for R1507 benefit
efficacy.judgement: Paired comparison: Gong 2009 predicted high total IGF-1R marks sensitivity; the trial's IGF1R-level subgroups showed no PFS effect on the primary endpoint. Abstract does not cite the panel, so comparison_stated false.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: PFS rate at 12 weeks by IGF1R-level subgroup vs predicted sensitivity of IGF-1R-high tumours
efficacy.model: 22-line NSCLC cell panel treated with R1507 (total IGF-1R as response marker)
A549 NSCLC xenografts in nude mice
efficacy.note: Dalotuzumab, the antibody the A549 model was run with, added to erlotinib did not lengthen PFS (2.5 vs 1.6 months, not significant). Combination trial, scored on its phase II primary endpoint (PFS).
efficacy.quote: The addition of dalotuzumab to erlotinib did not improve efficacy outcome in patients with refractory advanced NSCLC.
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading (PMID 25414803); primary phase II endpoint (median PFS) from the ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT00654420. No earlier congress abstract checked.
efficacy.reason: Model's own antibody gave no PFS benefit
efficacy.judgement: Split the A549 track by drug: h7C10 is dalotuzumab, so this is the model's own drug (product in model), paired with its randomized NSCLC add-on trial. Huang 2016 (dalotuzumab plus pemetrexed/cisplatin) agrees and is listed as a patient trial.
efficacy.magnitude_basis: PFS benefit of add-on vs near-complete xenograft growth inhibition, direction only

patient_trials.quote: PC + D had a similar response rate compared to PC, with a higher rate of hyperglycemia.

safety.model: A549 NSCLC xenografts in nude mice
safety.note: Xenograft studies reported no host metabolic toxicity; patients on cixutumumab had more grade 3-4 hyperglycemia (9.4% vs 1.2%). No published tox-species prediction found. Goetsch 2005 states no tolerability claim, so there is no passing safety prediction to score; xenografts used h7C10, not cixutumumab.
safety.quote: Grade 3 or 4 hyperglycemia occurred at a higher rate with cixutumumab than in the control (9.4% versus 1.2%).
safety.confidence_note: No regulatory non-clinical review exists for any member in NSCLC; GLP primate toxicology for cixutumumab, dalotuzumab, ganitumab or R1507 not found in published sources.
safety.judgement: Mouse xenografts with a human-specific antibody cannot show host insulin/IGF effects, so their silence on hyperglycemia is not scored as a miss.

safety.note: Roche's GLP monkey toxicology of R1507 (teprotumumab) began November 2004 and supported its oncology trials; no comparison with patients yet.
safety.short: Monkey GLP toxicology of R1507 begins
safety.quote: Ro 485-8696/F01-01(huMAb-IGF-1R): A 7-Week Intermittent Intravenous Toxicity, Toxicokinetic, and Immunogenicity Study with Ro 485-8696/F01-01 (huMAb-IGF-1R) in Cynomolgus Monkeys with an 8-Week Recovery Period
safety.confidence_note: Study title and initiation date (November 3, 2004) read in the FDA pharmacology/toxicology review text.
safety.judgement: Opening entry at the first GLP monkey study of a member antibody (R1507 = teprotumumab, Ro 485-8696).
safety.model: Cynomolgus monkey repeat-dose toxicology of R1507/teprotumumab

safety.note: NSCLC patients on R1507 plus erlotinib had hyperglycemia (grade 3-4 in 2% and 4% vs 0% on placebo); the monkey studies predicted none. This disease's patients were measured, so their result sets the status, not the TED harm. The monkey data were first public in the 2021 FDA review, after R1507's own patient hyperglycemia (2010-2011), so this is a retrodiction that failed to reproduce it: contra.
safety.quote: Notably, hyperglycemia was observed in only six patients treated with R1507.
safety.confidence_note: Ramalingam 2011 full text read on PMC (Table 2: hyperglycemia grade 3-4 in 2 and 4 percent of R1507 arms, none on placebo, P = .17). Monkey side from the FDA BLA 761143 pharmacology review, posted under nda/2021; exact posting date not verified.
safety.judgement: Monkeys can show glucose dysregulation, so their silence on hyperglycemia is a scored miss. FDA (TED patients) states: "the monkey model predicted the clinical reduced weight gain/weight loss and decreased serum ALP, but not the clinical infusion reactions, exacerbation of inflammatory bowel disease, or hyperglycemia." Rulings applied: harm imported from TED only when this disease has no patient data, and NSCLC R1507 patients were measured; safety retrodiction counts only the same drug's own earlier patient result, which R1507 had (the R1507 phase I cited by Ramalingam 2011, and Ramalingam 2011 itself).
safety.magnitude_basis: presence of hyperglycemia in R1507-treated NSCLC patients vs none in monkeys
safety.population: Advanced NSCLC after 1-2 prior regimens, R1507 plus erlotinib (NCT00760929)
safety.model: Cynomolgus monkey repeat-dose toxicology of R1507/teprotumumab
